exercises.name: Kettlebell squat
instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at chest height, elbows tucked in.
Feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Sit the hips back and down with the chest up, until the thighs are about parallel.
Drive through the whole foot to stand tall. Breathe out on the way up.

steps.caption: Stand tall with the kettlebell held at your chest.
Sit down between your heels, chest up, elbows inside the knees.

exercises.name: Seated chest press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Keep your back and head against the pad and your feet flat.
Press forward until the arms are nearly straight. Don't lock the elbows.
Return slowly until the handles are back level with your chest.

steps.caption: Handles level with mid-chest, back against the pad.
Press forward until the arms are nearly straight, without locking the elbows.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Lock the thighs under the pad and take a grip a little wider than the shoulders.
Lean back slightly with the chest up.
Pull the bar down to the top of the chest, driving the elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise under control until the arms are straight. Never pull behind the neck.

steps.caption: Arms straight overhead, thighs secured under the pad.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, in front of you. Never behind the neck.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
instructions: Feet braced on the footplate, knees slightly bent.
Sit tall with the arms long and the shoulders down.
Pull the handle to the lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Let the arms extend again without rounding the back.

steps.caption: Sit tall, arms long, feet braced, knees soft.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
instructions: Hold the weights with palms facing in (thumbs forward) and keep that grip throughout.
Keep the elbows by your sides. Only the forearms move.
Curl up, then lower slowly to straight arms.
The neutral grip is the elbow-friendly alternative to a standard biceps curl.

steps.caption: Arms at your sides, palms facing in, thumbs forward.
Curl up keeping the thumbs-up grip; elbows stay by your sides.

exercises.name: Supinated cross-body dumbbell curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side, arms nearly straight and palms facing forward (supinated).
Keep the upper arms and elbows close to the ribs, shoulders level and wrists straight.
Curl the right dumbbell diagonally across the front of the torso toward the opposite shoulder, keeping the palm turned up.
Lower the right dumbbell under control to the palms-forward start, then repeat with the left arm toward the right shoulder.
Alternate arms without swinging or rotating the torso. Count the prescribed repetitions for each arm.

steps.caption: Start with both palms facing forward and elbows beside the ribs.
Right arm: curl diagonally toward the left shoulder with a palm-up grip, then lower slowly.
Left arm: curl toward the right shoulder. Return under control and continue alternating.

exercises.name: Knuckle push-up
instructions: Use a padded surface and keep wrists straight; use palms instead if knuckles are uncomfortable.
Set fists below shoulders and extend the legs into a straight plank.
Bend elbows back about 45 degrees and lower the chest under control.
Press back up without letting hips sag.

steps.caption: Start in a straight plank on fists and toes.
Lower the chest, keeping the body in one straight line.

exercises.name: One-arm kettlebell row
instructions: Take a staggered stance, bend the front knee and brace the free hand on the front thigh.
Keep the spine neutral and let the kettlebell hang below the free shoulder.
Pull the elbow towards the hip without rotating the torso.
Lower slowly; repeat on the other side.

steps.caption: Brace with the free hand and let the kettlebell hang.
Draw the elbow beside the ribs; keep the torso still.

exercises.name: Leg extension
instructions: Set the machine so knees align with its pivot and the roller rests above the ankles.
Sit against the backrest and hold the side handles.
Extend both knees under control without locking them.
Lower slowly to the starting position.

steps.caption: Sit with knees bent and the roller across the lower shins.
Raise the roller until the legs are almost straight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold one kettlebell in both hands in front of the thighs.
Keep knees soft and push the hips back, maintaining a neutral spine.
Lower the bell close to the legs only as far as the back stays neutral.
Drive the hips forwards to stand; do not lean back.

steps.caption: Stand tall with soft knees and the bell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keeping the bell close and the back neutral.

exercises.name: Overhead press
instructions: Begin with weights at shoulder height and wrists above elbows.
Brace the abdomen with ribs stacked over the hips.
Press overhead without arching the lower back or locking elbows.
Lower under control. The illustration uses dumbbells; a kettlebell can be pressed one side at a time.

steps.caption: Start with weights at shoulder height.
Press overhead while keeping the ribs and hips stacked.

exercises.name: Forearm plank
instructions: Place elbows directly beneath shoulders, with forearms supported.
Extend the legs and support the body on forearms and toes.
Keep a straight line from head to heels and breathe normally.
Lower the knees when you cannot maintain that position.

steps.caption: Set forearms down with elbows beneath shoulders.
Lift the knees and hold a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Straight-leg lying raise
instructions: Lie on your back with arms beside the body and legs together.
Brace the abdomen and gently keep the lower back against the floor.
Raise the legs towards vertical without lifting the head or swinging.
Lower only as far as you can keep the lower back supported; bend knees if needed.

steps.caption: Lie back with the abdomen braced and legs extended.
Raise the legs towards vertical, keeping the back supported.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and knees soft.
Rise slowly onto the balls of both feet without rolling the ankles outwards.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower heels under control.
Use a stable support for balance if needed.

steps.caption: Stand tall with both heels on the floor.
Lift both heels, balancing over the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Heavy bag boxing
instructions: Wear boxing gloves and wraps, and use a securely mounted bag.
Take a balanced staggered stance with hands guarding the cheeks.
Rotate the rear hip and pivot the rear foot as the rear hand punches straight.
Return to guard under control; keep the wrist straight and avoid locking the elbow.

steps.caption: Set a balanced stance with both gloves guarding the face.
Throw a controlled rear straight punch, then return to guard.

exercises.name: VR boxing
instructions: Clear the play area, fit the headset and secure controller wrist straps.
Stand balanced with knees soft and controllers near the cheeks.
Extend a controlled jab without locking the elbow or stepping outside the safe area.
Return to guard and alternate as the activity requires.

steps.caption: Start balanced with the controllers in guard.
Extend a controlled lead jab, keeping the other hand in guard.

exercises.name: Battle ropes
instructions: Secure the rope at its midpoint to a suitable anchor and hold one end in each hand.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft and spine neutral.
Lift and lower the hands alternately to send waves towards the anchor.
Keep the torso steady and breathe normally.

steps.caption: Raise one hand as the other lowers, keeping a steady stance.
Switch the hand positions to continue alternating waves.

exercises.name: Kettlebell shrug
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and a kettlebell in each hand, arms straight at your sides.
Keep your head level and lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears without bending your elbows.
Pause briefly, then lower your shoulders slowly to the starting position. Do not roll your shoulders.

steps.caption: Start tall with shoulders relaxed and kettlebells at your sides.
Raise shoulders straight up, pause, then lower slowly without rolling.
